channel.title: ProjectCostKit
channel.description: Free home project calculators and cost guides: paint, flooring, tile, mulch, gravel, concrete, decks, drywall and pricing tools for contractors.

item.title: Lawn Mowing Pricing: How Much to Charge per Yard
item.description: Price mowing by time and hourly rate, not by guess. Worked yard example, per-visit and monthly math, plus a checklist to use today.

item.title: Insulation Calculator: Batts and Blown-In by R-Value
item.description: Work out batts or bags of blown-in insulation by area and target R-value, with Energy Star targets and a worked attic example.

item.title: Stair Calculator: Rise, Run and Stringers
item.description: Work out risers, treads, total run and stringer length for code-safe stairs, with the IRC limits and a full 9 ft worked example.

item.title: Brick Calculator: Bricks and Mortar for a Wall
item.description: Work out bricks and 80 lb mortar bags for a wall with the modular rate, openings, waste and a full worked example.

item.title: Retaining Wall Block Calculator
item.description: Count retaining wall blocks, caps, base gravel and drainage stone for any wall, with the formula and a fully worked example.

item.title: Deck Stain Calculator: How Many Gallons?
item.description: Find gallons of deck stain by deck size, wood condition and coats, using real label coverage for smooth and rough wood, plus a worked example.

item.title: Cost to Paint Kitchen Cabinets in 2026
item.description: Pro and DIY costs to paint kitchen cabinets in 2026, priced per door and per linear foot, plus paint amounts and quote checks.

item.title: Carpet Calculator: How Much Carpet Do I Need?
item.description: Work out how much carpet you need in linear feet and square yards from room size and roll width, with seams, pad and a cost guide.
